headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an overall effect size of 1.45 (95% CI: 1.19–1.78), suggesting that western pattern diet is associated with a higher risk of bladder cancer. However, this association should be interpreted with caution, as there was very high between-study heterogeneity (I² = 81.71%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
